name: protoc-gen-go

storage.rationale: This tool has no tool-owned persistent storage in the supported Vrooli workflow; the explicit empty declaration records that caches or credentials are owned by the invoking workflow.

description: Go protoc plugin used by packages/proto codegen (local plugin, no BSR fetch)
installHint: Installed via `go install google.golang.org/protobuf/cmd/protoc-gen-go@v1.36.11` (requires Go on PATH; binary lands in $GOBIN or $HOME/go/bin which Vrooli's setup symlinks into ~/.local/bin)
notes: Pinned alongside buf.gen.yaml; bump in lockstep with the proto-codegen byte-stability gate (`make check`).
